name: Tenjou Miu
source:
A younger Miu in Yukiha's timeline who was adopted by Yukiha and the girl he chose at the end of Fragment's Note. 

[spoiler]Her name was formerly Tachibana Miu (橘 美羽) before Yukiha adopted her.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]In Fragment's Note 2, Miu has grown into a young-adult and travels back to the past to give [url=https://vndb.org/c20877]Yukitsuki[/url] a happier ending, similar to future [url=https://vndb.org/c20878]Miu[/url] in Fragment's Note.[/spoiler]
